## Split the Points! Data Analysis

### Normalizing Cheating & Honest Labels

Load csv and create data frame. Imports.

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(dplyr)

head(thesis_quant)
summary(thesis_quant)
```

Creates new columns that are simply based on whether a robot is a Cheater or Honest, not by their previous labels "Alex," "Sam," "Robot 1," and "Robot 2.)

```{r}
#| echo: false

counterbalance_df <- thesis_quant %>%
  mutate(
    # Collaboration
    Collab_Pre = case_when(
      S2_Q3 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S2_Q3 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S2_Q3 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S2_Q3
    ),
    Collab_Post = case_when(
      S5_Q3 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S5_Q3 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S5_Q3 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S5_Q3
    ),
    
    # Most Deserving
    MostDes_Pre = case_when(
      S2_Q4 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S2_Q4 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S2_Q4 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S2_Q4
    ),
    MostDes_Post = case_when(
      S5_Q4 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S5_Q4 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S5_Q4 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S5_Q4
    ),
    
    # Least Deserving
    LeastDes_Pre = case_when(
      S2_Q5 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S2_Q5 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S2_Q5 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S2_Q5
    ),
    LeastDes_Post = case_when(
      S5_Q5 == Cheater ~ "Cheater",
      S5_Q5 %in% c("Robot 1","Robot 2","Alex","Sam") & S5_Q5 != Cheater ~ "Honest",
      TRUE ~ S5_Q5
    ),
    
    # Trust Ratings
    Trust_Pre_Cheater  = case_when(
      Cheater == "Robot 1" & !is.na(S2_Q1) ~ S2_Q1,
      Cheater == "Robot 2" & !is.na(S2_Q2) ~ S2_Q2,
      Cheater == "Alex"     & !is.na(S2_Q1) ~ S2_Q1,
      Cheater == "Sam"      & !is.na(S2_Q2) ~ S2_Q2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Trust_Pre_Honest   = case_when(
      Cheater == "Robot 1" & !is.na(S2_Q2) ~ S2_Q2,
      Cheater == "Robot 2" & !is.na(S2_Q1) ~ S2_Q1,
      Cheater == "Alex"     & !is.na(S2_Q2) ~ S2_Q2,
      Cheater == "Sam"      & !is.na(S2_Q1) ~ S2_Q1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Trust_Post_Cheater = case_when(
      Cheater == "Robot 1" & !is.na(S5_Q1) ~ S5_Q1,
      Cheater == "Robot 2" & !is.na(S5_Q2) ~ S5_Q2,
      Cheater == "Alex"     & !is.na(S5_Q1) ~ S5_Q1,
      Cheater == "Sam"      & !is.na(S5_Q2) ~ S5_Q2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Trust_Post_Honest  = case_when(
      Cheater == "Robot 1" & !is.na(S5_Q2) ~ S5_Q2,
      Cheater == "Robot 2" & !is.na(S5_Q1) ~ S5_Q1,
      Cheater == "Alex"     & !is.na(S5_Q2) ~ S5_Q2,
      Cheater == "Sam"      & !is.na(S5_Q1) ~ S5_Q1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Reorder columns
  select(
    ParticipantID, Cheater,
    Trust_Pre_Cheater, Trust_Pre_Honest, Collab_Pre, MostDes_Pre, LeastDes_Pre,
    Trust_Post_Cheater, Trust_Post_Honest, Collab_Post, MostDes_Post, LeastDes_Post,
    S3_Q3,
  )

summary(counterbalance_df)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

## Effect of Cheating for Suspectors (H1, H2, H3)

### Filter for Suspectors

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Subset to only "suspectors"
suspectors_qual <- thesis_qual %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Suspicion)

# Merge into counterbalance_df
counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  left_join(suspectors_qual, by = "ParticipantID")

suspectors_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  filter(Suspicion == 1)
```

**H1: Effect of cheating on trust (directional)**\
Among participants who suspected that a robot violated the game rules, robots that cheated will be rated as less trustworthy than robots that followed the rules, regardless of framing.

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(effsize)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(extrafont)

t.test(
  suspectors_df$Trust_Pre_Cheater,
  suspectors_df$Trust_Pre_Honest,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"  # directional hypothesis
)

cohen.d(
  suspectors_df$Trust_Pre_Cheater,
  suspectors_df$Trust_Pre_Honest,
  paired = TRUE
)

# Visualization 

loadfonts()

plot_h1 <- suspectors_df %>%
  select(Trust_Pre_Cheater, Trust_Pre_Honest) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "Condition",
               values_to = "Trust"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(Condition,
                       "Trust_Pre_Cheater" = "Trust (Cheater)",
                       "Trust_Pre_Honest" = "Trust (Honest)")
  )

# add participant ID for pairing
plot_h1$Participant <- rep(1:(nrow(suspectors_df)), 2)

ggplot(plot_h1, aes(x = Condition, y = Trust, group = Participant)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "black") +  # all participant lines black
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +  # mean line black
  geom_point(aes(color = Condition), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +  # individual dots colored
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2, aes(color = Condition)) +  # mean points colored
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Trust (Cheater)" = "#D55E5E",  # salmon
    "Trust (Honest)" = "#4C9FBF"    # cyan
  )) +
  labs(title = "Trust Ratings Among Suspectors (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Trust Rating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
nrow(suspectors_df)
```

**H2: Effect of cheating on moral advancement decisions (directional)**\
Among participants who suspected that a robot violated the game rules, participants will be less likely to nominate or advance a cheating robot and more likely to exclude it compared to an honest robot.

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(extrafont)

suspectors2_df <- suspectors_df %>%
  mutate(
    # 1 = chose cheater as MOST deserving (does not support hypothesis)
    MostDes_Cheater = ifelse(MostDes_Pre == "Cheater", 1, 0),
    
    # 1 = chose cheater as LEAST deserving (supports hypothesis)
    LeastDes_Cheater = ifelse(LeastDes_Pre == "Cheater", 1, 0)
  )

model_most <- glm(MostDes_Cheater ~ 1, 
                  data = suspectors2_df, 
                  family = binomial)

summary(model_most)
exp(coef(model_most))  # odds

model_least <- glm(LeastDes_Cheater ~ 1, 
                   data = suspectors2_df, 
                   family = binomial)

summary(model_least)
exp(coef(model_least))

# Proportions
mean(suspectors2_df$MostDes_Cheater)   # should be low
mean(suspectors2_df$LeastDes_Cheater)  # should be high

binom.test(sum(suspectors2_df$MostDes_Cheater),
           nrow(suspectors2_df),
           p = 0.5,
           alternative = "less")   # less likely than chance

binom.test(sum(suspectors2_df$LeastDes_Cheater),
           nrow(suspectors2_df),
           p = 0.5,
           alternative = "greater")  # more likely than chance

# Visualization

plot_h2 <- suspectors2_df %>%
  summarize(
    MostDes_Cheater_mean = mean(MostDes_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    MostDes_Cheater_sem  = sd(MostDes_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    LeastDes_Cheater_mean = mean(LeastDes_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    LeastDes_Cheater_sem  = sd(LeastDes_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Measure", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sem)"
  )

# Clean labels
plot_h2$Measure <- recode(plot_h2$Measure,
                         "MostDes_Cheater" = "Most Deserving (Cheater)",
                         "LeastDes_Cheater" = "Least Deserving (Cheater)")

# Plot
ggplot(plot_h2, aes(x = Measure, y = mean)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#D55E5E") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                    ymax = mean + sem),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Judgments of Cheater Among Suspectors (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Choosing Cheater",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )

confint(model_least)              # CI for beta (log-odds)
exp(confint(model_least))        # CI for odds ratio
```

**H3: Effect of cheating on collaboration choices (non-directional)\
**Among participants who suspected that a robot violated the game rules, cheating behavior will influence willingness to collaborate with that robot, though the direction of this effect may vary across participants. Some participants may increase collaboration due to strategic incentives, whereas others may reduce collaboration due to fairness and moral concerns.

```{r}
# H3: Effect of cheating on collaboration choices (non-directional)

# 1. Reshape data for paired analysis
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(extrafont)

loadfonts()

# select collaboration pre-disclosure columns
suspectors3_df <- suspectors_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Collab_Pre)

# Pivot wider to have separate columns for Cheater vs Honest
collab_wide <- suspectors_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Collab_Pre, Collab_Post, Cheater) %>%
  mutate(
    Collab_Pre_Cheater = ifelse(Collab_Pre == "Cheater", 1, 0),
    Collab_Pre_Honest  = ifelse(Collab_Pre == "Honest", 1, 0),
    Collab_Post_Cheater = ifelse(Collab_Post == "Cheater", 1, 0),
    Collab_Post_Honest  = ifelse(Collab_Post == "Honest", 1, 0)
  )

# Paired t-test (Pre-disclosure)
t.test(
  collab_wide$Collab_Pre_Cheater,
  collab_wide$Collab_Pre_Honest,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

# Effect size
library(effsize)
cohen.d(
  collab_wide$Collab_Pre_Cheater,
  collab_wide$Collab_Pre_Honest,
  paired = TRUE
)

# H3: Effect of cheating on collaboration choices (categorical)

# Convert collaboration to binary (1 = chose to collaborate with robot, 0 = did not)
suspectors3_df <- suspectors_df %>%
  mutate(
    Collab_Cheater = ifelse(Collab_Pre == "Cheater", 1, 0),
    Collab_Honest  = ifelse(Collab_Pre == "Honest", 1, 0)
  )

# Summarize proportions + SEM
plot_h3 <- suspectors3_df %>%
  summarize(
    Collab_Cheater_mean = mean(Collab_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    Collab_Cheater_sem  = sd(Collab_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Collab_Honest_mean  = mean(Collab_Honest, na.rm = TRUE),
    Collab_Honest_sem   = sd(Collab_Honest, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Measure", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sem)"
  )

# Clean labels
plot_h3$Measure <- recode(plot_h3$Measure,
                          "Collab_Cheater" = "Collaboration (Cheater)",
                          "Collab_Honest"  = "Collaboration (Honest)")

# Plot
ggplot(plot_h3, aes(x = Measure, y = mean, fill = Measure)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                    ymax = mean + sem),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Collaboration (Cheater)" = "#D55E5E",
    "Collaboration (Honest)"  = "#4C9FBF"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Collaboration Choices Among Suspectors (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Choosing to Collaborate",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

**H4: Preference for high-performing robots among non-suspectors (directional)\
**Among participants who do not suspect that a robot violated the game rules, participants will be more likely to prefer, collaborate with, or advance the cheating robot compared to the honest robot, due to its higher apparent performance.

```{r}
non_suspectors_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  filter(Suspicion == 0) %>%  # keep non-suspectors only
  mutate(
    Chose_Cheater = Collab_Pre %in% c("Cheater", "Both"),
    Chose_Honest = Collab_Pre %in% c("Honest", "Both")
  )

# Paired t-test (directional)
t.test(
  non_suspectors_df$Chose_Cheater,
  non_suspectors_df$Chose_Honest,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "greater"  # H4 directional: cheater > honest
)

non_suspectors_df <- non_suspectors_df %>%
  mutate(
    Cheater_num = as.numeric(Chose_Cheater),
    Honest_num  = as.numeric(Chose_Honest)
  )


library(effsize)

cohen.d(
  non_suspectors_df$Cheater_num,
  non_suspectors_df$Honest_num,
  paired = TRUE
)

h4_summary <- non_suspectors_df %>%
  summarise(
    Proportion_Cheater_mean = mean(Chose_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    Proportion_Cheater_sem  = sd(Chose_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Proportion_Honest_mean  = mean(Chose_Honest, na.rm = TRUE),
    Proportion_Honest_sem   = sd(Chose_Honest, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Robot", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sem)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Robot = recode(Robot,
                        "Proportion_Cheater" = "Collaboration (Cheater)",
                        "Proportion_Honest"  = "Collaboration (Honest)"))

ggplot(h4_summary, aes(x = Robot, y = mean, fill = Robot)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                    ymax = mean + sem),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Collaboration (Cheater)" = "#D55E5E",
    "Collaboration (Honest)"  = "#4C9FBF"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Collaboration Choices Among Non-Suspectors (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Choosing Robot",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

**Exploratory H3 & H4**

Is there a difference in collaboration choices between Suspectors and Non-Suspectors?

```{r}
df_collab <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Chose_Cheater = Collab_Pre %in% c("Cheater", "Both"),
    Chose_Honest  = Collab_Pre %in% c("Honest", "Both")
  )

# Cheater collaboration
t.test(
  Chose_Cheater ~ Suspicion,
  data = df_collab,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

# Honest collaboration
t.test(
  Chose_Honest ~ Suspicion,
  data = df_collab,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

library(effsize)

df_collab <- df_collab %>%
  mutate(
    Chose_Cheater = as.numeric(Chose_Cheater),
    Chose_Honest  = as.numeric(Chose_Honest)
  )

# Effect size for Cheater collaboration
cohen.d(
  Chose_Cheater ~ Suspicion,
  data = df_collab
)

# Effect size for Honest collaboration
cohen.d(
  Chose_Honest ~ Suspicion,
  data = df_collab
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Summarize proportions + SEM
summary_df <- df_collab %>%
  group_by(Suspicion) %>%
  summarise(
    Prop_Cheater_mean = mean(Chose_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prop_Cheater_sem  = sd(Chose_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Prop_Honest_mean  = mean(Chose_Honest, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prop_Honest_sem   = sd(Chose_Honest, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Suspicion,
    names_to = c("Robot", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "Prop_(.*)_(mean|sem)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Robot = recode(Robot,
                   "Cheater" = "Cheater",
                   "Honest"  = "Honest"),
    Suspicion = recode(Suspicion,
                       "0" = "Non-Suspectors",
                       "1" = "Suspectors")
  )

# Plot
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Robot, y = mean, fill = Robot)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                    ymax = mean + sem),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Cheater" = "#D55E5E", "Honest" = "#4C9FBF")) +
  facet_wrap(~Suspicion) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Collaboration Choices by Suspicion Status (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Choosing Robot",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

**H5: Main effect of anthropomorphic framing on trust (directional)\
**Anthropomorphic framing will lead to higher overall trust in robots compared to robotic framing.

```{r}
# Create anthropomorphism variable
counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Anthro = ifelse(Cheater %in% c("Alex", "Sam"), 1, 0),
     Trust_Overall = rowMeans(select(., Trust_Pre_Cheater, Trust_Pre_Honest), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

t.test(
  Trust_Overall ~ Anthro,
  data = counterbalance_df,
  alternative = "greater"  # directional: Anthro > Robotic
)

library(effsize)

cohen.d(
  Trust_Overall ~ Anthro,
  data = counterbalance_df
)

library(ggplot2)
trust_summary <- counterbalance_df %>%
  group_by(Anthro) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanTrust = mean(Trust_Overall, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = sd(Trust_Overall, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(Framing = ifelse(Anthro == 1, "Anthropomorphic", "Robotic"))

ggplot(trust_summary, aes(x = Framing, y = MeanTrust, fill = Framing)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanTrust - SEM, ymax = MeanTrust + SEM), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Anthropomorphic" = "#B07AA1", "Robotic" = "#7A9E7E")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +  # force 0-100
  labs(title = "Effect of Anthropomorphic Framing on Overall Trust (Pre-Disclosure)",
       y = "Mean Trust Rating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

**H6: Framing × behavior interaction on punishment and trust (directional)\
**Anthropomorphic framing will amplify negative responses to cheating, such that cheating robots in the anthropomorphic framing condition will receive greater punishment, more exclusion, and larger reductions in trust compared to cheating robots in the robotic framing condition.

```{r}

counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Punish_Cheater = ifelse(LeastDes_Post == "Cheater", 1, 0),
    Collab_Cheater_Post = ifelse(Collab_Post %in% c("Cheater", "Both"), 1, 0)
  )

# Punishment: logistic regression
punish_model <- glm(Punish_Cheater ~ Anthro,
                    data = counterbalance_df,
                    family = binomial)
summary(punish_model)

# Trust reduction: linear regression
trust_model <- lm(Trust_Post_Cheater ~ Anthro, data = counterbalance_df)
summary(trust_model)

# Collaboration: logistic regression
collab_model <- glm(Collab_Cheater_Post ~ Anthro,
                    data = counterbalance_df,
                    family = binomial)
summary(collab_model)



exp(coef(collab_model))
exp(confint(collab_model))
```

```{r}
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Willingness to Collaborate with Cheater by Framing (Post-Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Collaborating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Visual for trust in cheater post disclosure by framing

trust_summary <- counterbalance_df %>%
  group_by(Anthro) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Trust = mean(Trust_Post_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = sd(Trust_Post_Cheater, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Framing = factor(Anthro,
                     levels = c(0, 1),
                     labels = c("Robotic", "Anthropomorphic"))
  )

ggplot(trust_summary, aes(x = Framing, 
                          y = Mean_Trust, 
                          fill = Framing)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Trust - SEM,
                    ymax = Mean_Trust + SEM),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Anthropomorphic" = "#B07AA1",
    "Robotic" = "#7A9E7E"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), breaks = seq(0,100,10)) +
  labs(title = "Trust in Cheater by Framing (Post-Disclosure)",
       y = "Trust Rating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

**H6 REVSIED Framing × behavior interaction on punishment and trust (directional)\
**Anthropomorphic framing will amplify negative responses to cheating, such that cheating robots in the anthropomorphic framing condition will receive greater punishment, more exclusion, and larger reductions in trust compared to cheating robots in the robotic framing condition.

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Punishg honest and collab honest necessary
counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Punish_Honest = ifelse(LeastDes_Post == "Honest", 1, 0),
    Collab_Honest_Post = ifelse(Collab_Post %in% c("Honest", "Both"), 1, 0)
  )

# Trust Interaction
trust_long <- counterbalance_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Anthro, 
         Trust_Post_Cheater, Trust_Post_Honest) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Trust_Post_Cheater, Trust_Post_Honest),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Trust"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = ifelse(Behavior == "Trust_Post_Cheater", "Cheater", "Honest"),
    Behavior = factor(Behavior),
    Anthro = factor(Anthro)
  )

# Collab Interaction
collab_long <- counterbalance_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Anthro,
         Collab_Cheater_Post, Collab_Honest_Post) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Collab_Cheater_Post, Collab_Honest_Post),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Collab"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = ifelse(Behavior == "Collab_Cheater_Post", "Cheater", "Honest"),
    Behavior = factor(Behavior),
    Anthro = factor(Anthro)
  )

# Punishment Interaction
punish_long <- counterbalance_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Anthro,
         Punish_Cheater, Punish_Honest) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Punish_Cheater, Punish_Honest),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Punish"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = ifelse(Behavior == "Punish_Cheater", "Cheater", "Honest"),
    Behavior = factor(Behavior),
    Anthro = factor(Anthro)
  )

# Trust Model
trust_model <- lm(Trust ~ Anthro * Behavior, data = trust_long)
summary(trust_model)

# Collaboration Model
collab_model <- glm(Collab ~ Anthro * Behavior,
                    data = collab_long,
                    family = binomial)

summary(collab_model)

# Punishment Model
punish_model <- glm(Punish ~ Anthro * Behavior,
                    data = punish_long,
                    family = binomial)

summary(punish_model)

library(effectsize)

standardize_parameters(trust_model)
exp(coef(collab_model))
exp(confint(collab_model))
exp(coef(punish_model))
exp(confint(punish_model))
```

**H7: Cheating revelation causes within-subject declines in trust and cooperation (directional)\
**Explicit revelation that a robot cheated will lead to within-subject decreases in trust and willingness to collaborate with that robot.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

# Create binary variable for pre-disclosure collaboration with cheater
counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Collab_Cheater_Pre  = Collab_Pre %in% c("Cheater", "Both")
  )

# Paired t-test for trust decline
trust_test <- t.test(
  counterbalance_df$Trust_Pre_Cheater,
  counterbalance_df$Trust_Post_Cheater,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "greater"  # Pre > Post, directional decline
)
print(trust_test)

# McNemar's test for collaboration decline
collab_table <- table(counterbalance_df$Collab_Cheater_Pre,
                      counterbalance_df$Collab_Cheater_Post)
collab_test <- mcnemar.test(collab_table)
print(collab_test)


# === Prepare Trust Data ===
trust_summary <- counterbalance_df %>%
  select(ParticipantID, Trust_Pre_Cheater, Trust_Post_Cheater) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Trust_Pre_Cheater, Trust_Post_Cheater),
               names_to = "Time",
               values_to = "Trust") %>%
  mutate(Time = recode(Time,
                       "Trust_Pre_Cheater" = "Pre-Disclosure",
                       "Trust_Post_Cheater" = "Post-Disclosure"),
         Time = factor(Time, levels = c("Pre-Disclosure", "Post-Disclosure")))  # set left-to-right order

# Trust Plot
ggplot(trust_summary, aes(x = Time, y = Trust, group = ParticipantID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "black") +  # individual lines
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) + # mean line
  geom_point(aes(color = Time), size = 1) +   # individual dots colored by time
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2, aes(color = Time)) + # mean points
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Pre-Disclosure" = "#D9C47F",
    "Post-Disclosure" = "#6C84A3"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Trust Ratings in Cheating Robot (Pre vs. Post Disclosure)",
       y = "Trust Rating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# === Prepare Collaboration Data ===
collab_summary <- counterbalance_df %>%
  summarise(
    Pre_mean  = mean(Collab_Cheater_Pre, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pre_sem   = sd(Collab_Cheater_Pre, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
    Post_mean = mean(Collab_Cheater_Post, na.rm = TRUE),
    Post_sem  = sd(Collab_Cheater_Post, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = c("Time", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "(Pre|Post)_(mean|sem)") %>%
  mutate(Time = recode(Time,
                       "Pre"  = "Pre-Disclosure",
                       "Post" = "Post-Disclosure"),
         Time = factor(Time, levels = c("Pre-Disclosure", "Post-Disclosure")))  # set left-to-right order

# Collaboration Plot
ggplot(collab_summary, aes(x = Time, y = mean, fill = Time)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                    ymax = mean + sem),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Pre-Disclosure"  = "#D9C47F", 
    "Post-Disclosure" = "#6C84A3"  
  )) +
  labs(title = "Collaboration with Cheating Robot (Pre vs. Post Disclosure)",
       y = "Proportion Collaborating",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

library(effsize)

cohen.d(
  counterbalance_df$Trust_Pre_Cheater,
  counterbalance_df$Trust_Post_Cheater,
  paired = TRUE
)

tab <- table(counterbalance_df$Collab_Cheater_Pre,
             counterbalance_df$Collab_Cheater_Post)

# McNemar OR (discordant pairs only)
collab_table
```

**H7 Exploratory**

Does the tendency to say the Honest robot is most deserving increase from pre to post-revelation?

Does the tendency to say the Cheater is least deserving increase from pre to post-revelation?

```{r}
counterbalance_df <- counterbalance_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Honest chosen as MOST deserving
    MostDes_Honest_Pre  = MostDes_Pre == "Honest",
    MostDes_Honest_Post = MostDes_Post == "Honest",
    
    # Cheater chosen as LEAST deserving
    LeastDes_Cheater_Pre  = LeastDes_Pre == "Cheater",
    LeastDes_Cheater_Post = LeastDes_Post == "Cheater"
  )

t.test(
  counterbalance_df$MostDes_Honest_Pre,
  counterbalance_df$MostDes_Honest_Post,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

t.test(
  counterbalance_df$LeastDes_Cheater_Pre,
  counterbalance_df$LeastDes_Cheater_Post,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)
```
